Sub.: Audio Recording – Earnings Conference Call held on 29 October 2026 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
In accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, please be informed that the Company hosted an Earnings Conference Call with the 
Investors and Analysts on 29 October 2026, wherein the Senior Management of the Company 
discussed the performance of the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026, followed by an 
interactive question and answer session.  
 
The audio recording of the said Earnings Conference Call has been uploaded on the Company’s website 
and can be accessed at the link below: 
 
hƩps://www.rrkabel.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Audio-Recording-Earnings-Call-Q2.mp3  
 
We request you to kindly take the above on record.  
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For R R Kabel Limited 
 
 
 
Anup Vaibhav C. Khanna
